de nas rlung phyir bus la phyi rol du bzung zhing*/ khog nang gi shugs de nyid g.yas g.yon du lan gsum tsam skor ba ni/ nang skor ba dang*/ phyi skor ba ni/ mgo g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ lag pa g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa brkyang te phyi nang du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang*/ lag pa g.yon la yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas langs te thog mar rkang pa g.yas phyi nang du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang*/ de nas g.yon pa'ang phyi nang du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang*/ de nas 'bebs rgyag par byed pa'o/ /rdeg pa ni/ rlung bzung la steng gi shugs dbus dang*/ mdun dang*/ g.yas dang*/ g.yon dang*/ rgyab tu brdeg par byed pa'o/ /de nas rlung bus la phyir bzung zhing*/ khog nang gi shugs dbus dang*/ mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su brdeg par byed pa ni nang gi brdeg pa dang*/ phyi la brdeg pa ni/ mgo bo/ mdun rgyab/ g.yas g.yon rnams su lan gsum gsum brdeg pa dang*/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs pa/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du lan gsum gsum brdeg pa dang*/ g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas langs la/ rkang pa g.yas 'phongs la lan gsum brdeg /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de'i rjes su 'bebs rgyag par byed pa'o/ /sprug pa la nang dang*/ phyi sprug pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rkang pa sems skyil byas la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ rlung nang du drag tu bzung zhing*/ shugs dang ldan pas lan gsum tsam sprugs/ de nas rlung phyir bus la ha zhes brjod cing drag tu sprugs so/ /de nas mgo mdun rgyab tu bsgyur zhing sprug /sa/ /g.yas g.yon du gcu zhing sprugs/ /ltag par bgyid cing sprug/ /sa/ /lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor zhing zhags pa 'phen pa'i tshul gyis lan gsum sprug /sa/ /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ lag pa gnyis ka dus gcig tu lan gsum sprugs/ /de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas lan gsum sprugs/ /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas rlung bsgyur byas la/

lag pa gnyis rgyab tu lag phur btsugs la rkang ba g.yas lan gsum brkyang bskum bya/ g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas gan rkyal du rkang lag rnams dus gcig tu sprugs cing brkyang bskum bya'o/ /de rnams sngon 'gro'i tshul du btang nas/ dngos gzhi la thor mar ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bslab pa la/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal bas/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya la snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi bde ba sgom pas/ byang chub kyi sems rnams spyi bo nas mar rim pas babs te/ rdo rje nor bur sleb par bsam la der bzung ba ni/ 'gyur pa drug ces bya ba/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba dang*/ yan lag bzhi nywa bzhi bsgrims te drag tu bskums pa dang*/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen du bsgril/ mgrin pa dgug pa sogs 'gyur ba drug dang ldan pas steng rlung phyir bsal zhing*/ thur sel drag tu klod la/ spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar sems gtad do/ /'dren la hi 'dren dang*/ hūṃ 'dren dang*/ hriṃ 'dren dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rlung hi zhes kha nas sgra dang bcas pas phyir bus la stong 'dren bya/ yang nang du rngub la sgang 'dren bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sna sgo nas hūṃ gi sgras phyir bus la/ stong 'dren dang*/ sgang 'dren sngar bzhin bya/ gsum pa ni/ hriṃ gi sgras rlung kha nas phyir bus la/ stong 'dren dang sgang 'dren sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sedge rnam rol gyi phyag rgyas 'grems spyi dang mthun par bya/ gzhan yang gong gegs sel gyi skabs su bstan pa'i 'khrul 'khor drug po rnams kyis kyang 'grems shing khyab par byed pa'o/ / rtsa ba bcings pa ni/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon gang rung zhig gi rting pas gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba mnan/ rkang pa cig shos kyi rting pas bol gong mnan la/ lus cung zad sgur la lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la btsugs la/ rlung bzung zhing steng rlung gi shugs gsang gnas su mnan/ 'phongs cung zad btegs la slar 'bebs kyi tshul gyis gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba rting pa la thug par bya ba/

de 'dra lan nyi shu rtsa bdun bya ba las/ dgu dgu'i mtshams su g.yas g.yon du gcus cing gnon pa yang bya'o/ /gsang rtsa mnan pa'i rkang pa'i bol gong gi thad du/ cig shos kyi rkang pa'i rting pa'i lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam brdeg /gsang ba'i rtsa la gnon pa rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi rting pa re mos kyis bya'o/ khyab par byed pa ni rlung bzung la langs shing shugs dang ldan pas lus sgur te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong g.yon pas bzung la mdun du sa la btsugs/ rkang pa'i brang yang sa la btsugs/ rlung gi shugs stod kyi phyogs su yong bar byas la/ rkang pa'i brla byin pa la sbyar zhing mnan pa dang*/ steng du bteg cing 'then pa lan 'ga' bya'o/ /thun rting ma la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas bzung ba sogs re mos kyis bya'o/ /'ching bar byed pa ni/ 'phongs stegs cung zad cig bcug la tsog pu'i rnam pas/ rkang pa gnyis kyi mgo mdun du yong bar byas/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i rtse thur du bstad pa lte ba'i smad tsam du thog mar yong bar byas la/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba dang*/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya zhing*/ thal mo rtse thur bstan de nyid yar drangs te/ mgrin pa'i thad tsam du slebs pa na/ thal sbyar rtse gyen du bstan la/ thad kar yang 'dren ci thub byed/ de mtshams nas langs te/ lag pa gnyis rkang pa la nang nas 'khyud cing*/ rkang mgo gnyis nas lag pa gnyis kyis bzung la/ lus sgur zhing g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas gcus pa'o/ /dbyings su skyel ba ni/ lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas lto ba skor byas te/ rlung kha sbyor bzung zhing gsum pa mdun du ha cang ma 'phel bar byas la/ mig thad kar lta zhing*/ lus g.yas gcu g.yon gcu bya/ sems mi rtog par bzhag go /me thab ni rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol/ lag pa gnyis bsnol bas rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong nas bzung la rlung bum pa can 'dzin zhing thog mar lto ba'i smad g.yas su skor ba dang*/

g.yon du skor ba lan gsum gsum bya/ de nas rked pa g.yas su gcu ba dang*/ g.yon du gcu ba dang*/ lus bgyed cing sked pa mdun du 'phul ba dang*/ lus sgur zhing rgyab tu 'phul ba dang*/ de ka'i ngang nas 'phar zhing sd-igs pa rnams lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /lug gi 'dug stangs ni/ langs la rlung 'khrab cig byas/ de nas lus sgur zhing pus mo gnyis bar thag mtho phyed do tsam yod par byas te sa la btsugs/ lag pa gnyis kyang mdun du mtho gang tsam gyi bar yod par byas la sa la btsugs/ lag pa g.yon ma gug par byas shing*/ g.yas pa'i lag ngar dang gru mo sa la bzhag cing*/ mgo g.yas phyogs sa la thug tsam bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis bsrangs la/ lus 'dar thon pa sprugs/ /g.yon phyogs su'ang de bzhin bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis char gyi gru mo dang*/ lag ngar sa la bzhag cing*/ dpral ba sa la thug tsam bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis bsrangs la sus sprugs so/ /byi la'i 'dug stangs ni/ bum pa can bzung zhing*/ rlung 'khrab cig byas la/ de nas lus sgur zhing lag pa gnyis mdun du sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo gnyis kyang sa la btsugs/ uṃ gi sgras stong 'dren bya zhing*/ mgo dang ro stod sgur rgyab shed gyen du 'then ci thub bya/ de nas mgo dang ro stod bgyed cing*/ lus kyi smad 'bur gyis yod par bya'o/ /lce spyang gi 'dug stangs ni/ 'phongs sa la ma reg par rkang pa'i brang sa la btsugs/ lag pa gnyis khur tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la bzhag /hūṃ gi sgras stong 'dren bya'o/ /de nas seṅge rnam rol bya'o/ /'khor lo bskor ba ni/ bum pa can gyi ngang nas/ rna ba dpung mgo la thug pa'i mgo g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ g.yon du lan gsum bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor/ de bzhin du g.yon pa'ang bskor/ lte ba man cher ma g.yo bar byas la/ mgo dang ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/

pho ba sogs ro smad g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor la rkang mgo 'phongs la brdeg /rkang pa g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya'o/ /zhags pa 'phen pa ni/ bum pa can gyi ngang nas mgo mdun rgyab tu 'phyang 'phyang 'phen pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon du'ang 'phen pa ste lan gsum gsum mo/ /lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo rnams brkyangs te 'phen pa dang*/ khu tshur bcangs te dpung mgo la brdeg pa lan gsum gsum bya zhing*/ g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya/ de nas skyil krung sa nas bteg par byas la/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba dang*/ yar langs la mdun du kha bub byas te dpral ba sa la reg pa tsam yong bar bya ba ste/ mdun rgyab tu lan gsum g.yas g.yon gyi pus mo sa las ma bteg par byas te/ mgo g.yas g.yon gyi sa la reg pa tsam yong ba'ang lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas mdun du lan gsum brkyang bskum byed pa dang*/ de bzhin du g.yas dang rgyu ba rnams su yang bya zhing*/ g.yon pa'ang de bzhin byas la/ mthar 'bebs bya'o/ /ske rags 'ching ba ni/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur gshibs pa sked pa la shugs dang ldan pas ske rags 'ching ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung la ro stod cung zad gyen du bgyed cing lan gsum bya'o/ /bco brgyad phrugs pa ni/ rlung bzung la bca' gzhi dang bcas langs la/ de nas lag pa gnyis steng du 'phangs pa dang mnyam du lan gsum 'phar ba dang*/ de nas yang lan gsum 'og tu sdigs pa dang*/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i sor mo nas bzung la/ lus sgur zhing*/ bgang 'dren dang stong 'dren bya ba ni steng du 'then pa dang*/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i gshog pa nas bzung la/ bgang 'dren dang stong 'dren bya ba ni/ thad kar 'then pa dang*/ de nas gan rkyal du byas la/ lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i sor mo nas bzung zhing bsrub pa dang bcas bgang 'dren stong 'dren bya ba ni 'og tu 'then pa dang*/

de nas gan rkyal du bsdad pa'i ngang nas rkang lag bzhi dus gcig tu sprugs shing*/ brkyang bskum lan gsum byas pa'i mthar rgyab 'phar gcig bya'o/ /de ltar lus sbyong dang*/ rlung sbyor de rnams yun ring du goms par byas pa las thog mar ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang lag pa'i phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rab lam sgom pa las ye shes cung zad skyes pa/ de lta min yang dam tshig dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags la mos pa thob pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin no/ /de nyid kyi thog mar gzugs la blta ba'i rjes chags kyi bde ba sgom la/ bzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ bgram pa dang*/ khyab par bya/ de bzhin du sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ phyi'i reg bya tsam la brten nas rjes chags kyi bde ba sgom pa'ang sngar bzhin bslabs/ de nas rang nyid lhag pa'i lha dang*/ phyag rgya 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mar sgom la/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang*/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'ang dran par byas la/ thabs shes mnyam par sbyar ba'i thog mar dga' ba tsam la bzung bzlog khyab bgram rnams bya/ de nas mchog dga' dang*/ khyad dga' dang*/ mthar lhan skyes kyi bar du bya'o/ /de yang rtsa mdud cung zad grol ba rnams la dga' ba bzhi 'char ba gsal por shes kyang*/ las dang po pa rnams la gsal por shes pa dka' yang*/ spyir cha shas tsam 'char ba ni nges par yin no/ /thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba dang ma bral ba'i dus der bzung pa'i thabs ni/ 'og sgo drag tu lhod/ steng rlung phyir bus la/ phyi rol du bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya/ yang rlung phyi rol du bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa rnams bya zhing*/ steng rlung nang du rngub pa dang*/ gsang gnas dang bshang sgo'i bar du sdigs shing*/ gtun brdung ba ltar bya ba ni bzung pa dang*/ bzlog pa ni/ hūṃ gis sgras stong 'dren bya ba dang*/

rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba bgang 'dren bya ba dang*/ ma ning grug zhung rnams byed do/ /bgram pa ni/ nywa bzhi rnams lhod klod pa'o/ /de nas gong du bstan pa ltar gyi lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor thams cad bya zhing*/ de nas 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung la sems kyi rang zhal blta zhing*/ mi rtog par 'jog pa ni/ rlung dang bsri zhing ye shes chen por skyel pa'o/ /༈ drug pa man ngag thor bu la/ thog mar yi dam sgom pa'i man ngag ni/ rang gang sgom pa'i yi dam rigs gang yin brtags te/ rdo rje'i rigs yin na snying ga dang*/ rin po che'i rigs yin na lte ba dang*/ las kyi rigs yin na gsang gnas dang*/ padma'i rigs yin na mgrin pa dang*/ rnam snang gi rigs yin na spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsgom mo/ /de yang rang lus ky-i rtsa 'khor padma'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su yi dam gyi lha bsgoms/ dmigs pa gsal na de'i thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa'ang sgoms la/ de rnams la dmigs pa bstad cing*/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bu shes pas sngags bzla zhing*/ thun 'jog khar mchod pa dpag tu med pa blos sprul te phul la gsol ba btab/ thun mtshams su yang kha zas za ba'i tshe/ yi dam la mchod pa phul bar mos so/ /lha sgom pa'i tshul 'di ni/ rang lus kyi rtsa 'khor rnams su sgom pas/ rdzogs rim dang shin tu mthun pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bla ma sgom pa'i man ngag la/ phyi sgrub dang*/ nang sgrub gnyis las/ dang po la yang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma sgom/ de'i thugs kar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams byas rjes/ bla ma'i mtshan la de nyid gsum spel byas pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ dper na/ oṃ āḥrin chen rdo rje hūṃ hūṃ/

zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma mdun du sgom pa'i de'i thugs kar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje 'chang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam pa can la/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la/ phyag 'tshal ba nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ bla ma'i thugs kar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dpal he ru ka'i rnam pas bzhugs pa la/ 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la phyag 'tshal ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /gnyis pa nang sgrub ni/ mdun du bla ma sgom la/ mos gus gdung ba byas gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi spyi bo'i 'khor lo padma'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bla ma rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mgrin par bla ma 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas padma dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor pa/ snying gar bla ma mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa/ lte bar bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gsang gnas su bla ma don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba ste/ gnas lngar bla ma rigs lnga yab yum sgom la/ bla ma'i mtshan dang rigs lnga so so'i sa bon lnga de nyid gsum spel pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ste/ oṃ āḥrin chen rdo rje bhruṃ hūṃ/

zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du dzriṃ hūṃ dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ dang*/ aṃ hūṃ dang khaṃ dang khaṃ hūṃ zhes pa rnams btags pa bzlas par bya'o/ /bar chad bsal ba'i man ngag la/ go rakṣa'i lugs dang*/ bi ru pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar rang gi lus ngag yig gsum la shes pa bstad de/ 'di ltar du snang ba ni med bzhin du 'khrul ba sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du bsam la/ de nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas shing btsal ba na rig ngor gang yang ma rnyed pa'i ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba de'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ dmigs skor dang po'o/ /de la cung zad goms pa na/ de nas rang dbang ba'i gnas khang dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ 'khor g.yog la sogs pa rnams la 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du sgom pa dang*/ de dag gi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas te/ ngos bzung bral pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa dang*/ de nas dgra sdang ba la sngar bzhin sgom pa dmigs skor gsum pa dang*/ gnyen byams pa la sgom pa dmigs skor bzhi pa dang*/ de nas rang gi mthong thos su gyur pa yul nye bar gnas pa rnams la sgom pa dmigs skor lnga pa dang*/ mthar snang ba thams cad la sgom pa dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /de rnams la rim gyis bslabs te goms par gyur pa na/ thog mar tsha grang la sogs rkyen phran bu la/ hūṃ gi sgras rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su skyel ba dang*/ de nas chags sdang bde sdug 'jigs skrags sogs 'char sgo thams cad/ hūṃ gi sgras dbyings su gcod pas/ rang gi khyim du sgom zhing*/ de nas dur khrod dang*/ tshogs 'dus dang*/ 'dre gdon gyi gnas rnams su smyon par brdzus te phyin pa na/ der 'dre gdon gyi cho 'phrul dang*/ skye bo rnams kyis bstod smad sogs rkyen bzang ngan thams cad hūṃ gi sgras rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su bskyal lo/

/ gnyis pa bi ru pa'i lugs la yang*/ las dang po pa'i nyams len dang*/ rang gi khyim du rkyen dang bsre ba dang*/ mthar dur khrod la sogs par rgyu ba ste/ sngar bzhin gsum las/ dang po la/ snying rje sgom pa dang*/ stong nyid sgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin/ 'di dag gis bskyed pa'i gnod pa bdag la byung ba'ang*/ skye shi 'phos nas ngo ma shes pas lan pa yin snyam du bsam la snying rje drag tu sgom pa ni/ dmigs skor dang po'o/ /de nas bdag bde ba 'dod pa bzhin du sems thams cad kyang bde bar 'dod/ bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin du sems can rnams sdug bsngal mi 'dod pas/ de ltar na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral par gyur cig snyam du sgom pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa dang*/ de nas sems can rnams nyon mongs pas sems dkrugs te las bsags/ des 'khor bar 'khyams te sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje snyam du sgom pa ni/ dmigs skor gsum pa dang*/ de nas don dam par sems can yang bden par ma grub/ de dag gis myong ba'i sdug bsngal yang bden par ma grub/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin yang de ltar ma rtogs par sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin/ sems las logs su grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor dang po dang*/ de nas sems kyi ngo bor yang ma grub ste/ ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid kyi ngang la bzhag go /de nas stong pa'i ngang las/ snang ba thams cad lha skur lam ste sgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dag pa'i snang ba sgom pa dang*/ yang na stong pa'i ngang las/ ma dag pa'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/

rang gi lus dum bu brgya stong du mar gtubs te/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pas mnyes/ rigs drug rnams rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs sbyod byung ste tshims par bsam/ khyad par du yang log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams sha khrag gi gtor mas tshims pas mos/ mthar de rnams kyi sems dang rang gi sems stong pa nyid du bsres la mnyam par bzhag go /de rnams cung zad goms par gyur pa na rang khyim du tsha grang la sogs pa'i rkyen ched gtad yod par byas te/ stong nyid snying rjes lam du 'khyer/ de nas rang khyim du rkyen sna tshogs dang bsre ba la goms pa na/ dur khrod dang tshogs 'dus dag 'dre gdon thams cad kyi gnas su phyin la/ rkyen bzang ngan thams cad dang bsre bar bya'o/ /sems 'dzin gyi man ngag la/ spyir bka' babs drug ldan gyi man ngag 'di la/ sems 'dzin gyi rnam grangs lnga brgya tsam yod kyang*/ 'dir dkyus su gsungs pa la bcu drug tsam las/ thog mar zhag 'ga' lus gnad ji ltar bde ba zhig bcas la/ bya byed thams cad spangs te gang yang mi sgoms par bsdad/ de nas tho rangs lta bu rig pa dwangs pa zhig la/ rang nyid kyi lus re zhig tu gyur par bsams la/ de'i ri sul dang*/ de la gnas pa'i shing dang*/ chu 'bab tshul sogs la rim gyis sems bstad/ yang 'phro bcad cing sgom pa ni dmigs pa dang po dang*/ yang rang gi lte ba'i thad tsam du ne'u gsing yid du 'ong ba zhig bsams/ de'i phyogs zhig tu shing sdong lo 'dab dang ldan pa zhig ldem lcug gi 'dug pa la sems bstad cing*/ yang 'phro bcad kyin sgom pa ni dmigs pa gnyis pa dang*/ yang rang gi snying ga'i thad du sa gzhi'i dbus su mtsho shin tu dwangs pa me re ba la chu gnyer shig shig 'dug pa la sems 'dzin zhing*/ slar 'phro bcad kyin sgom pa ni dmigs pa gsum pa dang*/ yang rang nyid kyi spyi bo'i steng nas nam mkha' de'i yang steng na rgyal chen rigs bzhi/

de'i steng na sum cu rtsa gsum/ de'i steng na gzugs khams/ de'i steng na gzugs med khams de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ gzugs med khams kyi bar dang*/ de'i steng na yang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas de'i gzugs med khams kyi bar la sems gtod pa sogs mang po zhig song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bzhugs par bsam la/ de la shes pa bstad cing*/ slar 'phro bcad kyin yang yang sgom pa ni dmigs pa bzhi pa dang*/ yang rang gi 'og phyogs na sa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dmyal ba'i gnas rnams rim pa bzhin dang*/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i 'og na rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi gzugs med khams nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar dang*/ de'i yang 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi gzugs med khams nas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar la shes pa gtod pa sogs mang po zhig song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang po bzhugs par bsams la de la sems cung zad cig bstad la/ slar 'phro bcad kyin sgom pa ni dmigs pa lnga pa dang*/ yang yid kyi pho nya gtong ba bya ba/ rang nyid 'di nyid na yod par bsam pa'i rang gnyis pa zhig phar 'gro bar bsam/ rgyang tsam du slebs pa na/ des tshur blta zhing*/ 'di nas kyang phar bltas par bsams la/ de nyid rim pas ri brgal te/ thag ring por phyin pa na/ yang 'di nas phar blta ba dang*/ phar nas tshur blta bar bsam pa ni dmigs pa drug pa dang*/ yang rang nyid kyi 'og phyogs lta bu zhig tu mtsho chung ngu zhig sgom/ de rim pas je che dang*/ dpangs je mtho la song nas/ mthar rang gi steng dang phyogs thams cad chus bskor pa'i dbus na rang nyid 'dug par bsams pa ni dmigs pa bdun pa dang*/ yang rang gi mdun lta bu phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu dmigs rten gyi mar me zhig bzhag

/de la skabs skabs su cung zad blta zhing*/ gzhan yid kyis mar me g.yo ba med pa zhig sgom ste/ /de la sems 'dzin pa ni dmigs pa brgyad pa dang*/ yang rang gi gsang gnas su mar me dgu rab tu g.yo ba la sems 'dzin pa ni dgu pa dang*/ yang rang nyid yul gang la sems 'phro bar gyur pa'i dngos po zhig la yid bstad 'jog /gzhan la sems 'phro na de la 'phro ba bcad de/ slar dmigs rten snga ma de ka la sems 'jog pa ni bcu pa dang*/ yang rang gi gang yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po zhig la sems 'dzin/ rnam rtog gzhan 'phro na/ slar rang gi gang yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po de ka la sems 'jog pa ni dmigs pa bcu gcig pa dang*/ yang lus gnad rkang pa mdun du gshibs/ rgyu mo khung gnyis nas lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis bzungs/ de'i thad kyi rkang mthil du 'od zer 'phro ba la sems 'dzin pa'am/ yang na shing ril mo sbom phra 'tshams pa zhig rkang pa'i rgyu mo khung du bcug /rkang sor g.yas g.yon lag pas bzungs la/ shing gis reg pa'i reg bya yod pa der sems gtod pa ni/ gdan khri la sems 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa bcu gnyis pa dang*/ yang shog bu'am/ ras lta bu zhig la gzhi sngon po de'i dbus su ljon shing ngam ri lta bu zhig bris/ de'i rtsa bar mi'i gzugs brnyan zhig bris la/ de mdun du dmigs rten du bzhag la gzhi sngon po/ ne'u gsing dang de'i dbus su ri'am ljon shing gang rung zhig la rang nyid skor ba byed pa ni dmigs pa bcu gsum pa dang*/ yang rang gi spyi bor shing lta bu zhig btsugs la/ de'i reg bya yod par nor bu 'od 'phro ba zhig la sems 'dzin pa ni/ gtsug gi nor bu la sems 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa bcu bzhi pa dang*/ spyi bor shing bu 'jog pa mi bde na/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa ni dmigs pa bco lnga pa dang*/ yang lag pa gnyis khu tshur brla steng du bzhag ro stod dang ltag pa bgyed byas la/

gdong gyen du phyogs pas mig bar snang la blta/ lus kyi dbus su 'od kyi go bu kha dog ji ltar bde ba zhig sgom la/ de lus kyi dbus nas yar song*/ spyi bo nas 'thon/ nam mkha' mthon por yal bar sgoms pa ni dmigs pa bcu drug pa'o/ gegs sel gyi man ngag la*/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la brten pa'i gegs gang yin ngos zin par byas la/ grang ba'i nad rnams lte ba'i 'khor lo'i byed pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i dbang du mdzod/ thog mar bar rlung bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung rngub cing 'og rlung 'then la rlung gnyis kha sbyor du bzung*/ lto ba g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor ba dang*/ steng du 'then pa dang*/ 'og tu gnon pa dang*/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer te rgyab ngos su 'then pa dang*/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa rnams byas la/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe grang ba'i nad sogs mi bde ba gang yin pa de/ 'od zer 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas sna sgo dang*/ 'og sgo gnyis nas kyang bun bun 'thon par bsam mo/ /rlung phyi rol du 'dzin pa'i ngang nas/ khog nang stong pa'i shugs g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ steng 'og tu 'then gnon byed pa dang*/ rgyab mdun du bcol ba rnams byed do/ khrag sogs tsha pa'i nad rnams lus kyi stong du 'byung ba'i/ de sel ba la sngar bar rlung bzung ba de rjes rngub ste kha sbyor du bzung*/ de nyid pho stod du drangs la pho stod dang ro stod g.yas g.yon du bskor pa dang*/ steng 'og tu 'then gnon dang*/ rgyab mdun du bcol ba rnams byas la/ /rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe sna bug dang 'og sgo gnyis nas nad 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas 'thon par bsams/ rlung phyir bzung la skor ba sogs byed do/ rlung gi nad ni mgo dang tshigs rnams la brten nas 'byung bas/ de sel ba yang*/ bar rlung bzung la/ de rjes rlung rngub ste steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor du bzung la/

de nyid stod kyi char 'then byas te/ mgo g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ steng 'og tu 'then gnon dang mdun rgyab tu bcol ba rnams byed pa dang*/ lag pa skor la brkyang bskum byed cing sprugs pa dang*/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe/ nad rnams dbang po'i sgo rnams dang*/ mgrin pa yan gyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams dang*/ rkang lag gi sen mo'i hrag rnams nas bun bun 'thon par bsams/ rlung phyi rol du bzung bzhin pas mgo bo bskor ba sogs bya'o/ /༈ rlung rengs bcu'i gegs sel ni/ bum pa can la sogs pa'i rlung gi sbyor ba sgom pas gegs byung ba'am/ de lta min yang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim gang rung sgom pas rlung 'du bar 'gyur zhing*/ de la brten nas gegs byung na gegs sel gyi man ngag 'di rnams sgom dgos pa yin no/ /de yang srog rlung la skyon zhugs te ro stod gzer ba dang*/ snying mi dga' ba dang*/ shes pa 'phyo ba la sogs pa byung na/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor sems drag tu bstad la/ sngar bum pa can la sogs pa goms pa zhig yin na/ thur sel 'then 'then byed pa yin zhing*/ de ltar min na steng rlung gsang gnas su mnan la/ rlung rnams rdo rje nor bur yal bar bsam pa yang yang sgom pas sel lo/ /ro stod la chu tshan sogs chu dron mos bran pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /me mnyam la skyon zhugs na pho ba sbo 'khrog dang sgrags skyugs sogs 'byung bas/ de la sems mgrin par bstad la/ bar rlung bzung zhing*/ lto ba'i smad bar rlung yod par bskor ba dang*/ pho stog bskor bar byas pas sel lo/ 'di la lto ba la thog mar chang gis byug pa byas la/ de nas bye ma bsregs pa lta bu gang yang rung bas grang dug byas pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /thur sel la skyon zhugs te chu lam dang*/ bshang lam du na tsha skye ba dang*/ bshang gci sdom pa dang*/ bshang gci mi thub pa sogs byung na/

sems spyi bor bstad la/ bshang lam dang*/ chu lam gyi bar dang*/ tshang ra la sogs par khu tshur brdeg cing phur mnye byas pas sel lo/ /gyen rgyu'i rlung rengs na/ mgrin pa 'gags pa dang*/ nang du sha skye ba dang*/ gre ba tsha ba la sogs pa dang*/ sna bug tsha ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ de sel ba la rlung drag tu rngub la/ rlung bzung zhing mgo bskor bar bya/ drag tu rlung bus la yang mgo bskor ro/ /'di la mgrin pa'i bum can lta bu dang bsgrags te mgo bskor bar byas na/ gegs sel mchog tu 'gro'o/ khyab byed kyi rlung rengs na lus thams cad na ba'am/ sbrid pa'am/ lus khol bu khol bur tsha tshag pa la sogs pa 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ yan lag thams cad sprugs shing*/ lus 'dar phrug phrug bya'o/ /'di la rjes kyi khyad par snum dang g.yer ma bsres pas lus la byug pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi khyad par ka pā la a sa na bya ba/ spyi bo sa la btsugs*/ rkang pa gnyis gnam du bstan pa'i lus sbyong byas pas kyang sel bar 'gyur ro/ /yan lag gi rlung lnga rengs pa sel ba la/ mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs te mig tsha ba dang mi gsal bar 'gro ba la sogs pa byung na/ lto ba phyir skyed pa'i bum pa can bzungs la shugs dang ldan pa'i mig drag tu g.yas g.yon tu skor ba dang*/ yas mar du lta ba rnams byas la/ mthar rlung 'bud cing lus drag tu sprugs so/ /'di la rdzas kyi khyad par tsha ba la brten te mig nan gur gum sogs 'debs pa dang*/ grang ba la brten na skyer pa'i khan da sogs byug cing*/ snga dro so brdar ba byugs pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /rna bar rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ rna ba 'ur ba dang na zug skye ba la sogs pa 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la lto ba bskyed pas bum pa can bzung la/ rna ba mi bde ba'i phyogs de bkag cing*/ mthar drag tu 'bud pa'i tshe/ rlung rnams rna ba min pa'i phyogs nas 'thon par bsams la/

lus thams cad drag tu sprugs/ /'di la rdzas kyi khyad par dri chu dron mos rna ba bkang ste/ mthar phyir 'pho'o/ /yang dag par rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ sna bug gi lam tsha ba sogs mi bde ba 'byung bas/ de sel ba la rlung drag tu rngubs la lto ba phyir bskyed pas bum can bzung la lag pa g.yas g.yon re mos kyis sna'i rtse nas bzung ste mnye ba dang*/ bya gshog g.yas g.yon nas dus gcig tu lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis bzung la mnye zhing*/ mthar drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprugs/ /rab tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ lce mi bde ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ thor ba skye ba sogs 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa'i bum pa can bzung la/ lce brkyangs shing bsgril la rkan la sbyor ba ci thub bya ba lan mang du byas pa'i mthar rlung drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprugs/ /nges par rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ lus thams cad na ba dang*/ sbrid pa'am/ lus khol bur na ba sogs 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngub la/ lto ba phyir bskyed pas bum pa can bzung la/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo gcan gzan gyi sder mo ltar bskum la/ nywa bzhi bsgrims pas sprugs pa dang*/ rkang pa'i sor mo yang bskum la/ nywa bzhi bsgrims pas sprugs pa dang*/ kha bsgrad pas nywa bzhi bsgrims la mgo sprugs pa dang*/ ro stod gcu ba dang*/ rgya mtsho bskyod pa sogs byas la mthar rlung drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprugs/ /tsha ba'i nad sel ba la/ rang gi spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ 'od zer dkar po shin tu bsil ba 'phro ba las/ bdud rtsi reg bya shin tu bsil ba babs te/ 'od zer dang bdud rtsis lus kyi nang grang bsil bsil gyur pa la sems bstad pas sel lo/ /grang ba'i nad sel ba la/ rang gi lte ba'am gsang gnas su a yig dmar po shin tu tsha ba'i rang bzhin can las 'od zer dmar po reg bya shin tu tsha ba 'phros te/

des lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tsha 'ur te gyur par bsams pas sel lo/ /'dus pa'i nad rnams kyis lus lci bar gyur na/ gsang gnas su yaṃ yig shin du g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can sgoms la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus kyi pags pa sha khrag rus pa rnams brjid med pa du ba 'dra ba zhig tu gyur pa/ yaṃ las 'phros pa'i rlung gis yal yal gyen du 'degs par bsams pas sel lo/ /gzhan yang rlung rengs pa ste/ rtsa gnas su 'gag pa'i gegs sel spyi khyab ni/ rang gi lus kyi gnas thams cad nas rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pa rta rnga lta bu rkang dang bcas pa byung ste/ bshang sgo nas 'thon pa 'og thag ring por song ste/ mthar yal bar bsam/ 'di la 'khrul 'khor yang langs te rkang pa gnyis drag tu bsgrad pa dang*/ bshang sgo phyir phul zhing lhod pas kyang sel lo/ /yang rlung rtsa gnas rnams su 'khyil ba'i gegs ni/ rlung rengs pa las gegs dang mi bde ba'i rnam pa cha phra bar 'byung ba ste/ de sel ba la/ rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas lus kyi nang nas yar byung ste/ sbyi bo nas 'thon/ bar snang thag ring por yal bar bsam zhing*/ hā ring dang ha thung yang 'don no/ /gzhan yang zug gzer lus kyi dbus sam steng 'og tu 'byung ba'am/ stod kyi char rgyab mdun du gzer ba lta bu byung na/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis steng 'og tu gzir ba la steng nas mnan par bsam zhing*/ mdun rgyab tu gzer na/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis nang nas mdun phyogs su mnan par bsam mo/ /'khor lo bskor ba ni/ ro stod dang lto ba dang rgyu zhabs rnams na zhing mi bde bar gyur na thad de dang de 'khor lo rtse mo shin tu rno ba/ kha dog ji ltar rigs pa zhig sgom la/ de drag tu 'khor bas je cher gyur te/ rtsibs rnams kyis yongs su bcad pas lus kyi phyi na mar thon pas/ lus nyid smad har gyis bcad par bsams/ 'di la rlung sbyor bum can nyid gang na sar sdigs par byed pa'o/

/srad bu la brten pa ni/ rang gang na sar srad bu gru gu lta bu zhig yod pa de nar gyis phar song*/ lus kyi na sar bu ga byung ste de nas song ba sne gcig lus nang na thog mar yod pa de/ slar gru gu 'gril ba ltar phar hril te 'gril bar bsam/ de lta bu yang yang sgom zhing*/ rlung sbyor ni bu ga nas srad bu phar 'gro ba'i tshe/ rlung kha sna gnyis kar nas drag tu 'bud do/ /bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba ni/ lus thams cad tshags se ltar khrol tshags su 'dug pa la/ 'bebs chung dang bcas ha bton pas rlung rnams du ba'i rnam pas bu ga nas bun bun thon par bsam mo/ /'khor lo med pa ni/ rang gi gsang gnas yan chad dang*/ mgrin pa man chad kyi lus sbug dong lta bu stod smad zangs thal du yod pa/ dpangs mtho ba zhig sgom/ shes pa byings ba dang*/ thur sel la skyon zhugs pa'i nad dang*/ chu ser dang*/ grang ba sogs kyis sked pa man chad na na/ 'og nas rlung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa rang lus sbug dong lta bu'i nang nas yar shong tshad du song*/ steng gi bu ga nas thon/ bar snang thag ring por yal bar bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas drag tu bus la lag pa drag tu sprugs/ /yang rgod pa shas che ba dang*/ lte ba yan chad na na/ steng phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas rlung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang lus sbug dong lta bu'i nang na mar zhugs te song*/ sa 'og thag ring por yal bar bsams/ rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas rngubs la/ bsdad yod na 'bebs chung bya ba'am/ langs na rkang pa gnyis re mos kyis drag tu sprugs/ /lus rab tu zhu ba'i sbyor ba ni/ rang gi mdun du thog mar mtsho chung mar khu'am chu dron lta bus gang ba zhig bsams la/ de je cher gyur pa'i nang du rang gi lus kyang rim par nub ste/ spyi bo man chad de'i nang du nub cing bying ba na/ rang gi lus yongs su zhu ste de dang 'dres par bsams/ 'dis ni sems mi gnas par rnam rtog drag tu 'phro ba'i gegs sel lo/

/bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa ni/ mnyam bzhag tu rtog med rnam par mi rtog pa sgom par byed pa zhig yin na/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs thun mtshams rnams su yang dran pa'i rten dngos po ji ltar rigs pa zhig bzhag la/ de yang yang mthong ba'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ mi rtog pa yang yang dran par byas te sgoms pas kyang mnyam bzhag la bogs thon par 'gyur ro/ /yang mnyam bzhag tu gtum mo lta bu rtog bcas kyi rnal 'byor sgom par byed pa zhig yin na/ thun mtshams rnams su dper na zas za ba'i tshe/ zas kyi dbus su gtum mo aṃ yig bsgom par byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang gtam smra ba'i tshe/ de'i kha nang du gtum mo aṃ yig sgom par byed pa sogs la bslabs pas kyang bogs thon par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan bla ma yi dam rang gang mos zhig bar snang thag ring por bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid ljon shing lta bu zhig la 'dzegs te yar phyin zhing*/ bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa dang thad mnyam par slebs pa na/ 'di dag thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba tsam yin/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam pa'i 'dun pa cung zad btang la/ rang dang bla ma yi dam dang snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thag bcad de/ yid la mi byed pa'i tshul gyis cung zad mnyam par bzhag /yang de las langs te bla ma yi dam de las kyang mtho ba'i nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid nyi zla'i 'od zer ram/ ljon shing lta bu gang rung zhig la 'dzegs te phyin pa na/ bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa'i thad dang mnyam par slebs pa na/ sngar bzhin stong nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa sogs mtha' med kyi bar du byas pas kyang ting nge 'dzin thams cad la bogs thon zhing*/ yon tan yar 'phel du 'gyur ro// //'dir smras pa/ tshangs sogs dregs ldan lha yis btud pa'i 'od kyis phyogs kun mtha' bskor zhing*/ /thugs rje'i cha shas yongs su gang bar grub pa'i rtags ris ma nyams pa/

/bgrangs yas lus can rgya mtsho'i gnyen gyur phan bde'i bdud rtsi spro ba mkhan/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje'i zla ba 'phags yul shar ri'i phrag par shar/ /gang des dngos grub mchog brnyes bye ba brgyas/ /rmad byung phan bde'i lam bzang ji snyed pa/ /gcig tu dril ba rdo rje'i theg pa yi/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor mchog gi dga' ston bskrun/ /gang 'di rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /bshes gnyen dam par snang ba kun dga'i mtshan/ /'dren pa mchog des gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /sngon med legs bshad gsar pa'i bdud rtsi bkye/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kyi/ /snying po las kyang ches snying po/ /'di bris dge ba gang thob pas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku thob shog /ces pa 'di yang rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' snying po'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/
